# 💳 Firecrawl Shopping Research

💳 Requires a Firecrawl API key — the hosted service is paid (usage-based credits). Curated by Skill Harbor — a shopping-research workflow that compares products, prices, sellers and reviews across shops and produces a structured comparison — and stops at checkout: it never buys or proceeds to payment without your explicit approval. By @firecrawl, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it's a comparison brief, not a purchasing agent — prices and availability move fast, so re-verify at the merchant before buying; it works from publicly visible shop data only. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
